page_title: BOU 2-0 ARS | Bournemouth v Arsenal 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The total number of attempts is 13:6.
90+1' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
86' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

85' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Robert Jones with no other option than to blow for a foul.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Evanilson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
81' The substitution has been made. Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) has replaced Mikel Merino.
80' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Jakub Kiwior will be replaced by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
79' 2 - 0 Goal! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for David Raya to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
79' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
77' Referee Robert Jones sees the trip by David Raya (Arsenal) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Bournemouth!
76' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot well wide of the left post.
76' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
73' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:6.
70' 1 - 0 Goal! Justin Kluivert shows great vision to find Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the top left corner. 1:0.
70' Bournemouth take a short corner kick.
69' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a save.
68' That's a clear yellow card. Ben White (Arsenal) goes into the book.
67' There's an opportunity for Declan Rice (Arsenal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
65' Dangerous play by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth). Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is coming onto the pitch as Leandro Trossard cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' Substitution. Ryan Christie replaces Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
63' A substitution has been made. Alex Scott (Bournemouth) goes off and Justin Kluivert comes on.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) comes onto the pitch so that Dango Ouattara can be given a rest.
62' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
60' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
59' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alex Scott as he is replaced by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcus Tavernier departs the field of play to be replaced by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
59' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Jones saw the whole situation.
56' The game is interrupted. Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
56' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) commits a foul and Robert Jones immediately signals a free kick.
54' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
52' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
51' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
51' Declan Rice (Arsenal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
50' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

47' Ambitious effort from Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
46' Andoni Iraola has made a change at the break. Adam Smith (Bournemouth) has come on in place of Julian Araujo.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Robert Jones has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is penalised for a foul. Robert Jones had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45+2' The corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is intercepted by David Raya.
45+1' A rebound falls kindly for Thomas Partey (Arsenal), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Some patient build-up play from Bournemouth as they look to unlock the defence.

41' David Raya pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
38' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
37' The resulting corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) comes to nothing.
37' Substitution. Raheem Sterling is replaced by Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal).

36' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from David Raya, who tips the ball around the post.
36' Evanilson (Bournemouth) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
35' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
33' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes a short corner kick.

33' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
32' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
30' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to William Saliba (Arsenal). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
29' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for William Saliba (Arsenal)! Let's see what he decides.
28' What was William Saliba (Arsenal) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
27' Robert Jones has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
24' A cross into the box from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is cleared.
23' Flag goes up against Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
22' Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul after Thomas Partey (Arsenal) hacks down one of his opponents.
21' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:1.
18' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
16' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
15' Robert Jones blows for a foul after Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
14' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Gabriel (Arsenal) gets to the ball swung in from the corner and plants a close-range header low towards goal, but it's blocked then cleared away.
11' Declan Rice (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
10' Ben White (Arsenal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
10' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
7' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
6' Ben White (Arsenal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
3' Arsenal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
